tool.name: Foundry ProteinMPNN
tool.description: run the Foundry ProteinMPNN CLI on a structure dataset
tool.command: #set $config_arg = "" #if str($config) not in ["", "None"]: #set $config_arg = "--config '%s'" % $config #end if #set $weights_arg = "" #if str($weights) not in ["", "None"]: #set $weights_arg = "--weights '%s'" % $weights #end if #set $mpnn_command_arg = "" #if str($mpnn_command) not in ["", "None"]: #set $mpnn_command_arg = "--mpnn-command '%s'" % $mpnn_command #end if python '$__tool_directory__/run_foundry_mpnn.py' --structure '$structure' $config_arg $weights_arg --arguments '$arguments' $mpnn_command_arg --out-dir 'mpnn_output' --summary-json 'mpnn_summary.json' --archive 'mpnn_outputs.zip' --sequences-fasta 'mpnn_sequences.fasta'

param.name: weights
param.label: Optional weights path
param.help: Use __WEIGHTS__ in the argument template to insert this path.

param.name: arguments
param.label: Foundry mpnn CLI arguments
param.help: Use placeholders: __STRUCTURE__, __OUTPUT_DIR__, __CONFIG__, __WEIGHTS__. Check mpnn --help after installing Foundry and replace this template with the exact arguments for your MPNN mode.

tool.help:
This wrapper delegates to the Foundry ``mpnn`` command and collects FASTA files plus the full output directory. The current Foundry README marks the MPNN command line and JSON interfaces as still being documented, so the Galaxy tool exposes a CLI argument template rather than hard-coding unstable option names.
Use these placeholders inside the argument template:
- ``__STRUCTURE__``: copied Galaxy structure input - ``__OUTPUT_DIR__``: output directory for the MPNN run - ``__CONFIG__``: optional copied JSON/YAML configuration - ``__WEIGHTS__``: optional weights path field
After installing Foundry, run ``mpnn --help`` in the server environment and use the exact documented command arguments in this field.
